known_edge_cases.description: Affiliation axis labels (Non-Affiliated Issuer, Emerald JV LP, etc.) appended with pipe delimiter starting 2025-12-31. Stripped by canonical_strip_re for position key stability.
Numeric suffixes (1, 2, 3, ...) distinguish different loan tranches to the same borrower. These are separate positions, not duplicates.
Emerald JV LP and Verdelite JV LP sub-portfolios appear as separate rows from direct portfolio. Same underlying positions may appear under both direct and JV schedules.

Many positions appear twice per quarter with slightly different FV values, likely current-period and prior-period facts from the same XBRL filing. Up to 4x duplication in early quarters (2022-12-31) from period x dimension cross-product.
Placeholder identifiers 'Investment One' through 'Investment Seven' with FV=0, likely unfunded commitments or template rows.
JV entity rows (BCRED Emerald JV LP, BCRED Emerald JV) appear as aggregate-level entries with no rate/maturity/shares detail, representing entity-level fair values rather than individual positions.
The Dreyfus Government Cash Management Institutional Shares identifier is a retained cash position. Source context c-6032 in accession 0001803498-26-000031 reports FV and cost of USD 11,462,000.

Standalone Emerald JV LP and Verdelite JV LP pipe suffixes within InvestmentIdentifierAxis identify the underlying reporting portfolio. Parent LP-interest names without this suffix remain parent records.

Earlier InvestmentIdentifierAxis members carry the reporting portfolio as its own comma- or ordinal-separated segment, trailing or (2023-03-31) leading, or (2023-09-30 through 2024-03-31 only) as a bare-space-separated trailing segment with no comma or digit immediately before the label. Reviewed contexts: MH Sub I c-4761 in 0001803498-24-000007 and c-4323 in 0001803498-24-000022 (Verdelite JV LP after a legal name); 2U, Inc. ie581ddde7a204a18ab795e21c813585b_I20230331 in 0001803498-23-000012 (leading Emerald JV LP); Freeport LNG Investments, LLLP c-3470, Monk Holding Co. c-3527, Confine Visual Bidco c-3506 and Symphony Technology Group c-3548 in 0001803498-23-000017; AlixPartners, LLP c-4526 in 0001803498-23-000021; Auris Luxembourg III S.a r.l. c-3820 and Tangerine Bidco S.p.A c-3997 in 0001803498-24-000044. Bare-space contexts: Polyphase Elevator Holding Co. c-3367 in 0001803498-23-000021; Auris Luxembourg III Sarl c-3689 and c-4713, Corporation Service Company c-3813, Alterra Mountain Company (double space) c-4730, Confine Visual Bidco c-3831, Freeport LNG Investments, LLLP c-3801, Jayhawk Holdings, LP c-3928, Box Co-Invest Blocker, LLC c-3923 and GSO DL Co-Invest EIS LP c-3924, all in 0001803498-24-000007. Borrower legal-form words are not required. The fund's own BCRED Emerald/Verdelite JV LP interests and joint "and" forms (leading or trailing) remain parent records; both guards are load-bearing once the bare-space form is admitted. This scope interpretation does not strip the ordinal from the position identifier.

evidence.quote: Table 99 presents Total Investment Portfolio | 82,916,241 | 82,199,346, then a separate Cash and Cash Equivalents section, Total Cash and Cash Equivalents | 2,348,711 | 2,348,711, and finally Total Portfolio Investments, Cash and Cash Equivalents | 85,264,952 | 84,548,057.

For 2025-12-31 current holdings, rows with asset_category='CASH' total 8 rows and fair_value 429,819,000; current holdings fair_value is 82,629,165,000 versus the validated investment anchor 82,199,346,000, so the cash rows exactly explain the remaining overage.
fund_financials reports investments_at_fair_value 82,199,346,000 and total_assets 85,992,162,000 for 2025-12-31, confirming the anchor is investments only, not investments plus cash.

Across scoped anchored quarters 2022-09-30 through 2025-12-31, excluding asset_category='CASH' moves value_sum toward the investments_at_fair_value anchor and does not push any scoped quarter below its anchor.

agent_investigate_rules/1803498/exclude_.rationale: The conservation anchor is the filer's Total Investment Portfolio / investments_at_fair_value amount. Cash and cash equivalents are presented separately below that subtotal and are included only in a later portfolio-plus-cash total. Rows classified as CASH are therefore outside the investment fair-value conservation population and should not be summed against the investment anchor.
